In the table appended to the said Notification, for the existing entry against the Kolkata North, the same shall be substituted by the following entry, namely:— TABLE Name of District (1) District Election Officer (2) 14-Kolkata North Municipal Commissioner, Kolkata Municipal Corporation [F. No. 508/WB/2023] By Order, SUJEET KUMAR MISHRA, Secy.
